post.description: Map a call object to a CRM object using the specified engagement ID and external call ID. This endpoint is useful for associating call data with CRM records, allowing for better tracking and management of call-related activities within the HubSpot platform.

get.description: Retrieve the connection statuses of users for calling extensions in the HubSpot CRM. This endpoint allows you to check the current connection status for specified users, which can be useful for monitoring user availability or troubleshooting connection issues.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: A list of user IDs to retrieve connection statuses for. Each ID should be an integer.

post.description: Retrieve the connection statuses of multiple users in a batch operation. This endpoint is useful for checking the calling connection status of several users at once, which can help in managing and monitoring user connectivity within the CRM system.

get.description: Retrieve the connection status of the current user for calling extensions in HubSpot. This endpoint provides information about whether the user is connected to a calling provider, which can be useful for verifying integration status or troubleshooting connection issues.

post.description: Process an inbound call by sending the necessary details to HubSpot. This endpoint is used to handle completed calls from third-party services, allowing you to record call details and status. The request must include engagement properties, call status, and phone numbers, among other details.

Record details of an inbound call using the HubSpot API. This endpoint allows you to submit information about a completed third-party call, including engagement properties and call status. It is useful for integrating third-party calling systems with HubSpot, enabling seamless tracking and management of inbound calls.

Mark a call recording as ready for processing in the HubSpot CRM. This endpoint is used to update the status of a call recording, indicating that it is ready to be accessed or further processed. It requires an engagement ID to identify the specific recording.

get.description: Retrieve the channel connection settings for a specific portal in the HubSpot CRM. This endpoint provides details about the connected channels associated with the given portal ID, which can be useful for managing and configuring calling integrations.

parameters.name: portalId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the portal for which to retrieve channel connection settings.

post.description: Create a new transcript for a call or meeting event in your HubSpot account. get.description: Retrieve the transcript associated with a specific CRM object. This endpoint allows you to access the transcript details for a given object type and object ID, which can be useful for analyzing communication records or integrating with other systems.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the CRM object for which the transcript is being retrieved.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of CRM object for which the transcript is being retrieved.

get.description: Retrieve a specific transcript by its unique identifier. This endpoint allows you to access the details of a transcript, which includes information such as the transcript's creation and update timestamps, the associated object type and ID, and the source of the transcript. This is useful for accessing and reviewing call or meeting transcripts stored in your HubSpot account.

parameters.name: transcriptId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the transcript to retrieve.

delete.description: Delete a specific transcript from your HubSpot account using its unique identifier. This operation is useful for managing and removing unnecessary or outdated transcripts from your records.

parameters.name: transcriptId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the transcript to delete.

get.description: Retrieve the settings for a specific calling app identified by the appId. This endpoint is useful for developers who need to access the configuration details of their calling integrations within HubSpot. The response includes various settings related to the app's calling capabilities.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the calling app for which to retrieve settings. It is an integer.

post.description: Create or update the settings for a specific app in the HubSpot CRM calling extension. This endpoint allows you to configure various settings such as the app's name, URL, dimensions, and capabilities like inbound calling and custom objects support. It is essential for developers who need to manage app settings programmatically.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the settings are being configured. It is an integer.

delete.description: Delete the settings for a specific calling app in the HubSpot CRM. This operation removes the configuration associated with the given appId, ensuring that the app's settings are no longer active or available.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the calling app whose settings are to be deleted. It is an integer value.

patch.description: Update the settings for a specific calling app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify various settings related to the calling integration, such as the app's readiness, dimensions, and support for custom objects and inbound calling. Ensure that the appId is correctly specified to update the intended app's settings.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the calling app whose settings are to be updated. It must be an integer.

get.description: Retrieve the channel connection settings for a specific app in the HubSpot CRM. This endpoint provides details about the channel connection configuration, including its readiness status and associated URL. It is useful for developers who need to verify or audit the current channel connection settings for their app.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which to retrieve channel connection settings.

post.description: Create or update the channel connection settings for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to configure the readiness and URL settings for the channel connection associated with the given app. It's essential for managing how your app integrates with HubSpot's calling features.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the channel connection settings are being configured. It must be an integer.

delete.description: Delete the channel connection settings for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This operation will remove the channel connection settings associated with the provided appId, effectively disconnecting the app from the channel.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app whose channel connection settings are to be deleted. It is an integer value.

patch.description: Update the channel connection settings for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify the settings related to the channel connection, such as the URL and readiness status. It is useful for maintaining or altering the configuration of your app's channel connection.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the channel connection settings are being updated.

get.description: Retrieve the event webhook settings for a specific calling app in HubSpot. This endpoint allows developers to access the current configuration of webhook URLs associated with calling events for the specified app, identified by its appId.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the calling app whose event webhook settings are being retrieved. It is an integer.

put.description: Update the event webhook settings for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to configure the target URL for receiving webhook events related to calling activities. It is essential for integrating external systems with HubSpot's calling features.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the webhook settings are being updated.

post.description: Create a new event webhook for a specified app in HubSpot. This endpoint allows you to set up a webhook URL to receive event notifications related to calling activities. It is essential for integrating external systems with HubSpot's calling features.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the event webhook is being created. It must be an integer.

delete.description: Delete the event webhook settings for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This operation removes the webhook configuration associated with the specified appId, effectively stopping any event notifications from being sent to the previously configured URL.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app whose event webhook settings are to be deleted. It is an integer.

get.description: Retrieve the list of event webhook subscriptions for a specific app in the HubSpot account. This endpoint is useful for developers who need to manage or audit the event subscriptions associated with their app.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which to retrieve event webhook subscriptions.

post.description: Create a new subscription for event webhooks related to calling extensions in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to specify the type of event you want to subscribe to, such as TICKET_CREATED, CALL_CREATED, or CALL_UPDATED. It is useful for integrating with external systems that need to respond to these specific events.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the subscription is being created.

parameters.name: eventType
parameters.description: The type of event to subscribe to. Valid values are TICKET_CREATED, CALL_CREATED, and CALL_UPDATED.

delete.description: Delete a specific event webhook subscription for a calling app in HubSpot. This endpoint allows developers to remove subscriptions to particular events, such as ticket creation or call updates, for a given app identified by its appId. Use this endpoint to manage and clean up event subscriptions that are no longer needed.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the event webhook subscription is being deleted.

parameters.name: eventType
parameters.description: The type of event for which the subscription is being deleted. Valid values are 'TICKET_CREATED', 'CALL_CREATED', and 'CALL_UPDATED'.

get.description: Retrieve the recording settings for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows developers to access the URL used to retrieve authenticated recordings for the specified app. Useful for managing and configuring call recording settings programmatically.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which to retrieve recording settings.

parameters.name: appId

parameters.name: appId
